'''Tyler Sapius Praji''' was the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]], one of the original [[Core Founder/Legends|Founding Parents]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], and the progenitor of [[House Praji/Legends|House Praji]].

==Biography==
Tyler Praji was originally the governor and ruler of [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]], then a colony on the [[Koros Trunk Line/Legends|Koros Trunk Line]] at the edge of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], which had been established two centuries before the rise of the Republic by an older [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] civilization.

Though few records concerning his achievements survived to the present day, the achievement that earned him his place in history is that he was one of the signers of the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Galactic Constitution]], which established the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a government.

This assured Tyler his place in galactic history and established his descendants, the Prajii, as a long-lived aristocratic family that would endure for another twenty-five millennia and beyond. Millennia later, he was commemorated by an abstract statue outside the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
